bullets.title: META: $95B 2027 cash burn, equity raise imminent, capex scrutiny triggers -7% selloff
bullets.body: META fell ~7% Thursday as a 14C filing signals hundreds of billions in capital needs; 2027 cash burn estimated at ~$95B (FCF already turned negative at -$2.1B in Q3 on $34.9B capex). Multiple desks (MS TMT, 22V, Citi) flag an equity raise of $40B+ likely within weeks, with Berkshire cited as potential buyer; META bonds yielding 7%+ on 30-year maturities.

bullets.title: AI/Semi selloff: SOX -7%, NDX -2.9% — worst day since June; HF de-grossing accelerates
bullets.body: SOX posted its worst day in 5 months (-7%) driven by LRCX -12% on peak-capex guidance fears; Oct 22 was the 5th-largest de-grossing day of the year at -1.6 SD, entirely from long selling. Info Tech saw largest net selling since Sept 2024; global AI HF allocations fell to post-July lows; Tech L/S net leverage at 4th percentile. NDX forward multiple hit 20.3x NTM EPS, -1 SD below 10-year average.

bullets.title: WDC: Strong SepQ beat ($4.38B vs $4.1B cons), DecQ guide well above Street; HDD demand into 2031
bullets.body: Western Digital reported SepQ revenue $4.38B (+55% YY) and EPS $4.64 vs $4.11 Street; DecQ EPS guide $5.80 vs $5.20 consensus; gross margins 58.1% vs 55.7% Street. Management visibility extends through CY31; 40TB ePMR nearline mix accelerating (30%/50% Dec/Mar); HAMR qual MarQ27. Citi and Klein both maintain bullish view despite sympathy selloff.

bullets.title: BE: Third guidance raise; MS raises PT to $335, JPM OW at $292; ROTH cuts PT to $230
bullets.body: Bloom Energy beat Q3 and raised FY26 guidance for the third consecutive quarter: revenue +11%, operating income +17%, EPS +20%. MS raised PT to $335 (from $310), forecasting 2.1GW/3.7GW shipments in 2027/28; JPM rates OW with $292 PT on solid beat/raise. ROTH cut PT to $230 from $260 on sector multiple compression but maintained constructive view; YTD capex of $231M (~4x FY25) evidences capacity ramp.

bullets.title: CRWV: Needs $24-37B additional debt by YE27; unsecured bond spreads +300bps, stock -30% past month
bullets.body: MS TMT estimates CoreWeave requires $24-37B in additional debt financing to reach 3.3GW capacity by YE27 vs 1.85GW at YE26. Unsecured bond spreads have widened ~300bps since late August; neocloud basket (MSXXNEO) -7% near one-year lows; ORCL and CRWV CDS 5Y at widest levels. Hedgeye also flags Trump pressure on AI data centers to self-generate power as an additional cost headwind.

bullets.title: CMCSA: Wolfe maintains Peer Perform; NBCU spin mid-'27 key catalyst; 2027E EBITDA cut to $31.2B
bullets.body: Comcast 3Q revenue $29.30B and EBITDA $9.11B beat on cable/entertainment; domestic broadband losses -144K met lowered bar. Wolfe cut 2026 EBITDA to $32.81B (from $33.23B) and slashed 2027E to $31.18B (from $33.22B) as Starlink competition intensifies. Sum-of-parts values CMCSA at $25/sh (4.5x cable, 6.5x NBCU); M&A scenario at 13x NBCU EBITDA implies $34/sh.

bullets.title: APP: DADCO raises PT to $250 on premium-tier adoption at 36-37%; 3Q revenue +19% Y/Y
bullets.body: AppFolio posted 3Q revenue growth of 19% Y/Y with value-added services +21%; premium-tier penetration estimated at 36-37% vs 33% last quarter. DADCO raised PT to $250 (from $240) at 26x 2027 FCF; models 2027 revenue $1.32B (+17%) and EPS $8.51 (+23%). Stock down 53.5% YTD and at 52-week low per StreetAccount breadth data; Hedgeye maintains short on mobile gaming side (separate APP = AppLovin).

bullets.title: U vs APP: Hedgeye long U (Vector +23% seq), short APP on AXON model disruption
bullets.body: Hedgeye maintains SHORT AppLovin (APP) after 2Q26 missed revenue guide midpoint for first time in 15 quarters post-AXON model change; Street cut FY28 EBITDA 12%. Conversely, LONG Unity (U): Vector grew 23% sequentially vs 12-13% plan; primary research shows advertisers moving 10% of budget from APP to U with U advertiser count +37% since early July. APP earnings Nov 4, U earnings Nov 5.

bullets.title: STX: Q1 earnings preview Oct 27 — consensus $4.14B revenue, $7.42 EPS; options imply ~11.4% move
bullets.body: Seagate reports Q1 on Oct 27 after close; revenue consensus $4.14B vs guidance $4.1B ±$100M, EPS $7.42 vs guidance $7.30 ±$0.20. Data Center revenue expected $3.37B; non-GAAP gross margin 57.3%. STX has beaten EPS in 16 of past 20 quarters; stock up 14.1% since late July. WDC's strong quarter and management visibility into 2031 is a positive read-through for STX.

bullets.title: DKNG: NY sports betting GGR +95% Y/Y week ending 10/18; FanDuel gaining share, Caesars losing
bullets.body: New York OSB GGR surged 95% Y/Y for the week ending 10/18 with hold rate +450bps to 10.3%; 4QTD GGR tracking +25% Y/Y. DraftKings posted +79% weekly GGR growth with 32% market share (down 1pp vs PY). Caesars' 4QTD GGR is actually declining -4% Y/Y with market share slipping to 5% from 7%.

bullets.title: CCJ: Unusual options activity — 489% above avg volume, 36.91 P/C ratio signals heavy call buying
bullets.body: Cameco (CCJ) saw 123,617 options contracts trade at 489% above average volume with a 36.91 P/C ratio, indicating heavy call buying. No specific catalyst cited in the flow data beyond the broader nuclear/uranium thematic.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone Duo shipment target raised 44% to ~14M units for first 12 months
bullets.body: Apple is raising its iPhone Duo supply target from ~10M to ~14M units for the first 12 months; analyst commentary views the increase as not a material upside driver given potential cannibalization of other iPhone models. AAPL hit a 52-week high at $347.50, +34.5% YTD.

bullets.title: CDNS: Mizuho expects beat & raise on FQ3 (Oct 26); EDA momentum sustains
bullets.body: Mizuho is hosting a debrief call post-CDNS FQ3 earnings (reporting Oct 26) and expects the company to beat and raise, citing sustained EDA momentum. No specific estimates provided in the invite.

bullets.title: Mag-7 earnings preview: MSFT/GOOGL Oct 28, AMZN Oct 29, AAPL Nov 2 — positioning at widest in years
bullets.body: Hyperscaler earnings begin today with META/TSLA; MSFT and GOOGL report Oct 28 (same day as FOMC hold); AMZN Oct 29, AAPL Nov 2. JPM notes Nasdaq vs Russell positioning gap at +3.4 standard deviations — widest ahead of any Mag-7 earnings season since 2021. Hedgeye flags next week MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN as key catalysts to determine if capex concerns are repriced.

bullets.title: SMCI/NTNX: Joint AI inference solution targeting enterprise cost reduction
bullets.body: Super Micro and Nutanix announced a joint engineered solution for Enterprise AI inference designed to reduce customization costs. Super Micro had also positively preannounced stronger AI-platform demand and larger enterprise customer mix per the weekly bullish summary.

bullets.title: T/VZ: Down 4-5% pre-market on SpaceX fourth-carrier threat; tower stocks up 10%+
bullets.body: AT&T fell 5.3% and Verizon fell 4.7% in pre-market trading after reports that SpaceX is in talks with Crown Castle, American Tower, and Vertical Bridge to access 80,000+ cell sites to build a fourth national wireless carrier. Tower stocks (CCI, SBAC, AMT) rose 10%+ on the incremental lease revenue prospect; Citi and the Comms team view telcos as net-negative and towers net-positive from the build.

bullets.title: INFY: Revenue guidance cut to +1-2% from +1.5-3%; ACN sympathy -2.8% pre-market
bullets.body: Infosys cut FY revenue growth guidance to +1-2% from +1.5-3%, sending shares down 8.3% pre-market. Accenture fell in sympathy -2.8% on the read-through for global IT services demand.

bullets.title: MRNA: Citi maintains Sell, $80 PT; melanoma data approvable but not 'paradigm-shifting'
bullets.body: Moderna closed -18% on intismeran (ALN-HTT02 is ALNY; MRNA's mRNA-4157) melanoma data; Citi agrees the drug is approvable in adjuvant melanoma but disputes the platform narrative, citing complexity vs. already-approved pembrolizumab alternatives. Citi maintains Sell/High Risk with $80 PT, implying ~50%+ downside from current levels even under best-case assumptions. Phase 2 RCC data (YE26) will be the next major test.

bullets.title: CZR: Q3 earnings Oct 27 after close; consensus $2.96B revenue, 4QTD OSB GGR declining -4% Y/Y
bullets.body: Caesars reports Q3 on Oct 27 with FactSet consensus at $2.96B revenue, $936.2M EBITDA, -$0.12 EPS; options imply ~4.9% move. EPS beat rate is weak (only 4 of past 20 quarters). Separately, CZR's digital/OSB business is losing ground — NY 4QTD GGR declining -4% Y/Y with market share slipping to 5% from 7%, the worst trajectory among major operators.

bullets.title: FSLR: Trading ~5x 2027E EBITDA with integrated cost moat; Q3 bookings expected well above 1-2GW typical
bullets.body: ROTH highlights First Solar's integrated cost structure (mid-20s c/W vs domestic peers at ~40c/W) as a durable moat at ~5x 2027E EBITDA. Q3 bookings are expected well above the typical 1-2GW range with pricing ~2 c/W above Q2 ASP. ~40GW already warehoused in US restricts near-term new supply competition.
